basic_info.description: Prepare to be charmed by this expansive, updated Edwardian condo offering an incredible lifestyle - a walker's paradise just moments away from the best amenities and green spaces of Pacific Heights, Cow Hollow, the Marina and Russian Hill. Boasting a impressive living space with a generous floor plan, this home has been thoughtfully maintained throughout the years. Situated within a stately 3-unit building, it offers great scale and flexibility, along with room for personalization, if desired.  The floorplan is adaptable to a variety of needs and uses (think family area, office / WFH, play room, or in-home gym). Charming period details like softwood floors, coved ceilings, and crown molding add to the home's classic character, and tall ceilings & windows brighten the rooms throughout. The updated kitchen and bathrooms enhance convenience, along with in-unit laundry. Additional storage space on the ground level complete the home's amenities. With a Walk Score of 99, just blocks from the vibrant shopping and dining corridors of Union, Chestnut, Fillmore, & Polk Streets. An opportunity well-suited for many uses and life stages, including an owner occupier or investor looking for a rental offering with a strong history of past income!
